image_description: A white and blue minibus parked on an asphalt surface. The vehicle features a boxy body, a row of side windows, and a large windshield. There is prominent text on the side ('AIRARE RO') and front. The wheels appear standard for a van/bus. The background includes trees and a cloudy sky.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the characteristic high-roof, short-wheelbase proportions of a minibus (likely a Ford Transit or similar chassis). It is clearly distinct from a full-size city bus.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large, single-pane windshield is visible. A continuous row of rectangular passenger windows runs along the side, consistent with the class definition.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle has significant height relative to its width. A sliding door track and handle are visible just behind the front wheel arch, indicating a front/mid-body entrance.
The vertical seam and handle configuration behind the driver's cab are consistent with a sliding side door mechanism common in minibuses.
There is a distinct hood/bonnet section forward of the windshield and cabin, indicating a front-engine layout typical of this vehicle class.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is taken from a front-three-quarter angle; the rear of the vehicle is completely occluded and outside the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bus is painted white with a blue lower stripe and specific lettering/logos, fitting the 'company livery' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible front wheel is proportional to the vehicle body, appearing to be a standard 15-16 inch commercial van wheel with a simple rim design.
Based on the number of side windows (approx. 3-4 visible) and overall length, the capacity aligns with the 4-10 passenger range defined for minibuses.

artifact_observations.location: Side panel lettering ('AIRARE RO') and front grille badge
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the side appears to be pseudo-text or a hallucinated brand name ('AIRARE RO' does not correspond to a known major operator, and the font kerning is slightly irregular). The front badge is illegible smudge-like text. This is a common AI artifact where text structure is mimicked but semantic correctness fails.

The reflections in the side windows are somewhat muddy and lack the sharp, crisp environmental mapping expected in a high-resolution photograph. The black pillars between windows blend slightly into the glass.
The geometry of the front right headlight and the bumper line below it is slightly soft and indistinct. The turn signal light seems to merge into the bumper rather than having a clear bezel boundary.
